reply_text:
I told Dana in a reply to her #north-team message that the settled figure for Quarrendon Freight Lines' 2026 renewal is **261 seats**. Ilse posted that number in #north-team on Oct 14, and nothing in the channel since then changes it.

I also pointed out that the 185 Dana posted in August 2025 was the seat count under Amendment No. 1, so it isn't the renewal figure. A seat count isn't a money term, so it was fine to share with the North team.
